pages.description: The Forge by Keycap Studios: a Windows creator suite for video editing, music, clipping, thumbnails and multistreaming.

props.title: Everything you create,
props.text: The Forge is a Windows creator suite: edit videos, make music, cut clips, design thumbnails and stream everywhere at once, all from one hub.

props.title: The apps
props.subtitle: One hub, a growing toolkit. Start with the free editor and add what you need.

items.title: ForgeCut
items.text: The core video editor. Fast timeline editing, with optional AI Edit to rough-cut your footage for you.

items.title: ForgeCast
items.text: Record and multistream to YouTube (landscape and vertical), Twitch, TikTok and Kick at the same time.

items.title: Fluxa Studio
items.text: A music workstation for intros, beds and soundtracks without leaving your workflow.

items.title: ForgeClip
items.text: Turn long streams and videos into short clips ready for Shorts, Reels and TikTok.

items.title: Phibi
items.text: A thumbnail editor built for the click: layers, text, effects and quick templates.

items.title: ForgeLink
items.text: Ties it all together: move projects, clips and assets between the apps in one click.

props.title: Built for how creators actually work
props.subtitle: No subscriptions to five different tools. One launcher, one Steam account, everything updated automatically.

items.title: One hub
items.text: Launch every app, manage projects and see updates from a single place.

items.title: Auto-updates
items.text: New versions roll out automatically, so you're always on the latest build.

items.title: Sign in with Steam
items.text: Your Steam account unlocks everything you own, on any PC.

items.title: Your files stay yours
items.text: Projects and media live on your PC. Nothing is uploaded unless you publish it.

props.title: Coming soon to Steam
props.text: The Forge is in development. Wishlist it on Steam to get notified at launch.

props.html:
This policy explains how Keycap Studios ("we", "us") handles information when you use The Forge and its apps (ForgeCut, ForgeCast, Fluxa Studio, ForgeClip, Phibi and ForgeLink), and the website keycapstudios.com.

1. Information we collect

  • Account information: you sign in with Steam. We receive your public Steam ID and public profile name and avatar. We do not receive your Steam password or email address.
  • YouTube access: only if you choose to connect YouTube, we receive permission to manage your live broadcasts and upload videos on your behalf.
  • Purchase and licence information: which apps or add-ons you own, so we can unlock them. Payments are handled by Steam or our payment provider; we never see your full card details.
  • Basic technical data: app version and crash reports, used to deliver updates and fix bugs.

Your videos, music, projects and other media stay on your computer. We do not upload them anywhere unless you tell the app to publish or stream them.

2. How we use Google user data

Google is not used to sign in to The Forge. If you choose to connect a YouTube channel, The Forge uses the YouTube Data API only to perform actions you start in the app, such as creating a live stream, going live or uploading a video you selected.

The Forge's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

  • We do not sell Google user data.
  • We do not use Google user data for advertising.
  • We do not use Google user data to train AI or machine-learning models.
  • We do not let humans read your Google data, except with your explicit permission, for security purposes, or where required by law.

3. Where data is stored

YouTube access tokens are stored encrypted on your own computer. Account and licence records are stored on our servers so your purchases follow you between PCs.

4. Sharing

We only share data with services needed to run The Forge (for example Steam for sign-in and purchases, Google/YouTube when you stream or upload, and our hosting provider). We do not sell personal information.

5. Your choices

  • Disconnect YouTube or sign out at any time inside the app.
  • Steam sign-in can be managed in your Steam account settings.
  • Revoke The Forge's access to your Google account at myaccount.google.com/permissions.
  • Ask us to delete your account and data by emailing privacy@keycapstudios.com. We will do so within 30 days.

6. Data retention

We keep account data while your account is active. If you delete your account, we remove your data except where we must keep limited records (such as purchase records) by law.

7. Children

The Forge is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their data.

8. Your rights

Depending on where you live (including under South Africa's POPIA and the EU/UK GDPR), you may have the right to access, correct or delete your personal information, or object to how it is used. Contact us to make a request.

9. Changes

We may update this policy. If changes are significant we will notify you in the app or on this page.

10. Contact

Keycap Studios, South Africa
Email: privacy@keycapstudios.com

These terms apply to The Forge, its apps and add-ons, and keycapstudios.com, provided by Keycap Studios ("we", "us"). By using them you agree to these terms.

1. Licence

We give you a personal, non-transferable licence to install and use The Forge and any add-ons you have obtained. You may not resell, redistribute, reverse-engineer or remove copyright notices from the software.

2. Accounts

You are responsible for your account and for activity under it. Keep your sign-in secure and tell us if you think it has been misused.

3. Purchases and add-ons

Some apps and features (such as AI Edit and add-on apps) are paid. Purchases made through Steam follow Steam's refund policy. Prices may change, but changes won't affect things you've already bought.

4. Your content

You own everything you create with The Forge. You are responsible for making sure you have the rights to the footage, music and other material you use, stream or upload, and that your use follows the rules of each platform (such as YouTube, Twitch and TikTok).

5. Third-party services

Streaming and uploading features connect to services we don't control. Your use of them is also governed by their terms, including the YouTube Terms of Service.

6. Updates

The Forge updates automatically to fix bugs and add features. We may change or remove features over time.

7. Disclaimer

The Forge is provided "as is". We work hard to keep it reliable, but we can't guarantee it will be error-free. Keep backups of important projects.

8. Limitation of liability

To the extent allowed by law, Keycap Studios is not liable for indirect losses, lost data or lost profits from using The Forge. Our total liability is limited to what you paid us in the 12 months before the claim.

9. Termination

You can stop using The Forge at any time. We may suspend accounts that break these terms or misuse the service.

10. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of South Africa.

11. Contact

Email: hello@keycapstudios.com
